descriptions.line_profile: Measure values along a straight line in one archived scan frame without changing the instrument. p1 and p2 are either {x, y} in display pixels of that frame's full image or {x_nm, y_nm} in scan-frame nm. The flattened frame (default plane) is interpolated bilinearly at most one scan pixel apart and averaged across width_px. The reply gives distance_nm from p1 and the values (values_pm for Z, values_pa for current) per sample; the line's length and direction in the scan frame; the straight segments of a piecewise-linear fit (from_nm, to_nm, slope, mean); and step candidates where the segments on either side of a short transition differ by at least 4 noise sigmas: position_nm along the line, the scan-frame x_nm and y_nm, the height (right side minus left side, e.g. height_pm) and transition_nm. A bump wider than the transition window appears as a rise and a fall. One plot of the profile is returned and archived as a derived frame (plot.frame). It measures; it does not decide what a step or a feature is. Keys carry their unit: _nm, _deg, _px, and for channel values _pm (Z), _pa (current), _hz (frequency shift), _v (voltage).
descriptions.stats: Summary statistics of one archived scan frame, or of a region of it (display pixels of the frame's full image), without changing the instrument: mean, standard deviation, min, max and percentiles of the raw values; RMS roughness, mean absolute deviation and peak-to-valley after subtracting a plane fitted to the region; the correlation and RMS difference between the forward and backward passes (both plane-flattened) when both exist; a line-noise index (median absolute offset between consecutive row medians divided by the plane-flattened standard deviation); and the fraction of rows acquired. Keys carry their unit: _nm, _deg, _px, and for channel values _pm (Z), _pa (current), _hz (frequency shift), _v (voltage).
